figures.caption: Fig. 1. UnSPC consists of two key modules: (i) UnSPL mines reliable pseudo-labeled samples; (ii) CycAG cyclically alternates DA and DG.

Fig. 2. The overall framework of our UnSPC. A: Robust Pre-training Decoder (RPD) pre-trained on the source domain for initialization. B: Uncertaintyguided Self-paced Pseudo-labeling (UnSPL) selecting and weighing reliable samples on the target domain to form a reliable domain. C: Cyclic AdaptationGeneralization (CycAG), cyclically alternating between adaptation and generalization using reliable pseudo-labeled samples.

Fig. 3. Feature distributions and motor trajectories of ideal (supervised), static (uncalibrated), alignment-based method (WDGRL) and our UnSPC on C0–C1. A and B: Feature distributions under different alignments colored by values of speed and direction. C: Motor trajectories colored by trial direction.
